Contract AirportSystem::createStaff(id: Integer,name: String,pswd: String,phone: String,role: Integer,bossid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(Staff) = Staff.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = id),
		boss: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = bossid)
	precondition:
		obs.isEmpty() = true and
		boss.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let staff: Staff in
		staff.oclIsNew() and
		staff.Id = id and
		staff.Name = name and
		staff.Password = pswd and
		staff.Phone = phone and
		staff.Role = role and
		staff.Boss = boss and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(staff) and
		result = true
}
